plugin.name: 📑 Table of Contents
plugin.description: Insert or refresh a clickable Table of Contents in the current note, linking each heading via noteplan:// URLs.
plugin.author: dmangin

plugin.commands.name: Insert/Update Table of Contents
plugin.commands.description: Inserts a TOC under the first H1 heading, or refreshes it if already present.

plugin.commands.name: Remove Table of Contents
plugin.commands.description: Removes the existing TOC block from the current note.

plugin.settings.title: Maximum heading level
plugin.settings.description: Include headings up to this level in the TOC. Example: 3 → H1, H2, H3.

plugin.settings.title: TOC marker line
plugin.settings.description: The line used to identify the start of the TOC block. Must start with '## ' so it is treated as a heading by NotePlan.

plugin.settings.title: Bullet prefix
plugin.settings.description: String prepended to each TOC entry (between the tabs and the link). Default: '- '. Leave empty for no prefix.
